disambiguation: Not a Kanban board inside Obsidian; it only links the vault to the external Imdone app.
extras: Setup requires the vault to be the same folder as the Imdone project; a video tutorial is referenced, and vault changes only take effect after closing and reopening it.
intentEvidence: While the Obsidian Kanban Plugin is ideal for visual organization within notes, Imdone stands out for developers
problem: Imdone cards live in an external app, so Obsidian offers no way to jump between a card and the exact file line it was created from.

relations.evidence: allows you to integrate the Imdone Kanban board with your Obsidian vault
